newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin meeting with speaker scheduled for Friday.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin meeting with speaker scheduled for Friday.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin will meet the speaker of the upper chamber of parliament, Yegor Stroyev, on Friday, the Kremlin said on Thursday.

Stroyev had told the Federation Council on Wednesday he would meet the president the following day to discuss economic problems. But a Kremlin spokesman said the meeting would not be held until Friday. He gave no details.
Russia is in the grips of a coalminers' strike over unpaid wages.
On Wednesday, Yeltsin left the Barvikha sanatorium outside Moscow and moved to the Gorky-9 residence several kilometres (miles) away.
Yeltsin, 65, who is convalescing after heart bypass surgery on November 5, had been at Barvikha since November 22.

Doctors have said that, Yeltsin, who is already working several hours a day, should be back at his Kremlin desk this month. Medical staff say he is recovering well from the quintuple bypass operation to relieve clogged cardiac arteries.
